meta.description: Image-upload manifest. Every image on the platform is an UPLOAD SLOT identified by a stable key. The v3 admin portal writes an image_url here when a photo is uploaded (exactly like Family Shoppers stores image_url per product). When a slot has a url, it overrides the bundled default asset; when empty, the generator falls back to the asset path defined in the data files.

portalMapping.resolution: uploads[slotKey] -> else data-file asset path -> else placeholder
portalMapping.url: may be an absolute CDN url or an app-relative /storage/... path written by the portal
portalMapping.reimportSafe: empty/missing keys never wipe an existing upload (same rule as ProductImporter)
